autoSavePausedTitle: Auto-save paused: file was deleted from disk. Save manually with {{shortcut}}.
divergentTitle: Local differs from disk. Save ({{shortcut}}) to sync, or use File > Revert to discard local changes.
mcpListenerFailedTitle: This window cannot answer AI requests: its MCP request listener failed to start. Restart VMark to try again.
mcpHistoryNoRevisions: No revisions recorded for this document yet.
mcpHistoryUnavailable: The edit history could not be read.
mcpHistoryReasonExternalReload: the file was reloaded from disk
mcpHistoryReasonUncertifiedRange: an edit that could not be traced
mcpHistoryReasonUnclosedEpoch: an editing session that did not close
mcpHistoryReasonParentMismatch: the history and the document disagree
mcpHistoryStatusFailed: The edit history is unavailable — changes are not being recorded.
mcpHistoryStatusReadOnly: The edit history is read-only — new changes are not being recorded.
mcpHistoryStatusDegraded: The edit history is behind — some records are queued and not yet on disk.
mcpHistoryStatusLiveUpdatesFailed: Live updates from other windows are unavailable — the history refreshes every few seconds instead.
mcpHistoryStatusDocQueued: Changes to this document are queued and not yet recorded.
mcpHistoryStatusRefused: The last save was not recorded in the history ({{code}}).
mcpHistoryStatusTimeout: The last save was not recorded: the history did not answer in time.
mcpHistoryStatusBlocked: Changes whose automatic revert is blocked: {{count}}
mcpHistoryStatusFailedBecause: The edit history is unavailable — changes are not being recorded ({{detail}}).
mcpHistoryStatusStartupProblem: Part of the edit history's startup failed: {{detail}}
mcpHistoryStatusRegistrationCapRefusals: AI edits were refused in windows with too many open pages: {{count}}
mcpHistoryStatusUncertifiedFallbacks: Edits recorded as whole-document changes (their changed range could not be confirmed): {{count}}
mcpHistoryStatusIdentityDisabled: History recording is off because the document identity index could not be used: {{detail}}
mcpHistoryStatusIdentityUnbound: History recording is suspended because document identity could not be updated.
mcpHistoryStatusRetentionNearCap: Edit history storage limits nearly reached: {{count}}
mcpHistoryStatusRetentionPinnedOverCap: Edit history storage limits exceeded by history that must be kept: {{count}}
mcpHistoryStatusRetentionBlobError: Edit history cleanup could not remove unused data: {{detail}}
mcpHistoryStatusRetentionFailed: Edit history cleanup could not run: {{detail}}
mcpHistoryEarlierHint: Kept from before the edit history, for every document and window.
mcpHistoryEarlierFallback: Could not open {{path}} — restored into a new document
mcpHistoryRestoreFailed: Could not restore: the document was edited, or the history is unavailable
mcpHistoryRestoreAppliedWithError: Restored the version, but the editor reported an error — check the document
mcpHistoryRestoreRecoveryRequired: Could not confirm the restore — this document stays locked for agent edits until VMark restarts
mcpHistoryNotDurable: VMark could not confirm the edit history was saved to disk
mcpHistoryClearedTextPending: Cleared all checkpoint history. Their text stays on disk until the next compaction
mcpHistoryClearFailed: Could not clear the checkpoint history: the history is unavailable
mcpHistoryUncommittedHint: Applied to the document, but the history could not record them.
mcpHistoryUncommittedRestore: Restore the text this unrecorded write found
mcpHistoryUncommittedRestored: Restored the text from before the unrecorded write
mcpHistoryUncommittedFailed: Could not change the unrecorded write: the document was edited or the history is busy
yamlWysiwygBlocked: WYSIWYG mode would corrupt YAML indentation. Edit YAML in source mode.
terminal.search.label: Search terminal output
terminal.maximizeHint: Drag to resize · double-click to maximize
lint.badge.tooltip: {{count}} issue(s) — click to go to next
lint.badge.tooltipSingle: 1 issue — click to go to next
largeFile.switchToWysiwygAria: Switch this document from Source mode to WYSIWYG
tabDrag.newWindow: Drop to create a new window
tabDrag.lastTab: Cannot move the last tab in the main window
terminal.noWorkspaceSession: Open a folder or save your file to use the terminal
unparseable.openedInSourceMode: Opened in Source mode (cannot be displayed in WYSIWYG).
review.title: Review AI Changes
review.allReviewed: Every AI change in this document is reviewed.
review.hunkConflicted: Overlaps another change, so it cannot be reverted automatically. Edit it by hand, then mark it handled.
review.hunkEditedSince: Edited since this change was made
review.clearMessage: {{count}} reviewed changes will be settled and leave the review list for good. Settled changes can no longer be kept, reverted or undone here. This cannot be undone.
review.backlogFull: This document holds {{count}} unreviewed AI changes, the most it can hold. AI edits to it are refused until you review them and choose Clear reviewed.
review.editedInTwoWindows: Edited in two windows: this save started from a different version than the one before it. Restore either version to undo the merge.
review.pairAgainstStart: Against the version this save started from
review.pairFailed: Could not load both changes. The edit history refused or failed the read.
review.loadFailed: This part of the history could not be loaded.
review.pairCoarse: Too complex to split: shown as one change.
review.outcomeRevertedNotDurable: Change reverted, but VMark could not confirm the history was saved to disk
review.outcomeRevertedWithError: The document changed, but the revert did not finish cleanly. Check the document.
review.outcomeRevertedWithErrorNotDurabl: The document changed, but the revert did not finish cleanly, and VMark could not confirm the history was saved to disk. Check the document.
review.outcomeRecoveryRequired: The revert could not be confirmed. The document stays locked for AI edits until VMark restarts.
review.outcomeConflicted: Not reverted: this change overlaps another one. It is now marked as conflicted.
review.outcomeFoundBase: Nothing to revert: the text is already back to how it was before this change
review.abortedEdited: Not reverted: the document was edited meanwhile. Try again.
review.abortedClosed: Not reverted: the document was closed or saved under another name
review.abortedComposing: Not reverted: finish the text you are composing first
review.abortedSelection: Not reverted: the selection changed meanwhile. Try again.
review.abortedApplyRefused: Not reverted: the planned revert no longer fits the document
review.refusedAmbiguous: Not reverted: VMark can no longer tell exactly where this change is
review.refusedConflicted: Not reverted: this change still overlaps another. Edit it by hand, then mark it handled.
review.refusedReapply: Not reverted: this change was already reverted
review.refusedStale: The review list was out of date and has been refreshed. Try again.
review.refusedStaleParent: The document changed in another window. The review list has been refreshed.
review.refusedBacklogFull: Too many unreviewed changes in this document. Review them and choose Clear reviewed.
review.refusedExhausted: This change has been toggled too many times. Choose Clear reviewed to settle it.
review.refusedBusy: VMark is still recording another change to this document. Try again in a moment.
review.refusedOther: The edit history refused this action ({{code}})
review.actionFailed: The action failed. The review list has been refreshed.
comments.title: Comments
comments.loadFailed: The comments could not be read. They are read again when the edit history changes.
comments.onCaret: On the paragraph at the cursor
comments.widened: This selection cannot be matched exactly, so the comment will quote every block it touches, in full.
comments.noSelection: Select text or place the cursor in the editor first.
comments.anchorAmbiguous: The quoted text now appears {{count}} times, so this comment cannot tell which one it means.
comments.anchorOrphaned: The quoted text is no longer in the document.
comments.anchorHeading: Found under its heading: the text around it changed.
comments.anchorAnywhere: Found elsewhere in the document: the text around it changed.
comments.deleteMessage: The resolved comment and its replies will leave this document for good. This cannot be undone.
comments.refusedStale: The comment changed meanwhile. The list has been refreshed. Try again.
comments.refusedNotAllowed: This comment no longer allows that action. The list has been refreshed.
comments.refusedStorageFull: Comment storage is full. Deleted comments are reclaimed when VMark restarts.
comments.refusedLimit: This comment or document has reached its size limit.
comments.refusedAnchorTooLong: The selected text is too long to quote. Select a shorter passage.
comments.refusedExhausted: This comment has changed too many times to change again. You can still resolve or delete it.
comments.refusedBusy: The edit history is busy recording a save. Try again.
comments.refusedStaleParent: The document changed in another window. Try again.
comments.refusedOther: The edit history refused this action ({{code}})
comments.failed: The action failed. The list has been refreshed.
comments.abortedEdited: Not added: the document was edited meanwhile. Try again.
comments.abortedClosed: Not added: the document was closed or saved under another name
comments.abortedComposing: Not added: finish the text you are composing first
comments.abortedSelection: Not added: the selection changed meanwhile. Try again.
comments.abortedApplyRefused: Not added: the edit history answered unexpectedly
